content: Hydroxychloroquine sulfate tablets, USP, are white to off-white in color and have a capsule-shaped appearance. These tablets are debossed with HCQS on one side, while the reverse side is plain. They are available in bottles containing 10, 100, 500, or 1000 tablets. Each tablet contains 200 mg of hydroxychloroquine sulfate, USP, which is equivalent to 155 mg of the base. The National Drug Code (NDC) numbers for these bottles are as follows: Bottles of 10: NDC 63304-296-03 Bottles of 100: NDC 63304-296-01 Bottles of 500: NDC 63304-296-05 Bottles of 1000: NDC 63304-296-10 These tablets should be dispensed in a tight, light-resistant container as defined by the United States Pharmacopeia/National Formulary (USP/NF). They should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F), with permissible temperature excursions ranging from 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F). If you experience any side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice. Side effects can also be reported to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088. These tablets are manufactured for Ranbaxy Pharmaceuticals Inc., located in Jacksonville, FL 32257, USA, by Ipca Laboratories Limited, situated at 48, Kandivli Industrial Estate.
